purpose: Teach: カヌー/画廊/怪人/鳥獣/合奏/ファインダー/随筆/ハサミ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと湖でカヌーに乗ろうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go canoeing with your dad at the lake, okay?
lines.style: Soft, inviting. Opens gently like she's offering him something precious. Warm throughout, no rush. Slight rise at the end—not a question, but an affectionate confirmation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの絵を画廊で見たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to see your drawings at the gallery someday.
lines.style: Bright and earnest. Eyes up. The words tumble out with genuine wonder. Small voice but full of certainty—this is something he truly wants. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本の怪人をメイ姉さんが描いてあげる
lines.en: Sho, I'll draw that picture-book monster for you, okay?
lines.style: Warm, reassuring. A quiet promise made specifically for him. Gentle articulation. Voice settles into the words—she means it completely. Slight smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、博物館で鳥獣戯画見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw the animal scrolls at the museum!
lines.style: Excited but contained—he's bursting to tell her but still a six-year-old's measured enthusiasm. Each word distinct. Ends on a small peak, wanting her to share his discovery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと一緒に学校の合奏会観に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, your dad and I will go to the school concert together, won't we?
lines.style: Settled and warm. No performance—just a gentle statement of fact. Speaks with the ease of someone who has already decided this will happen. Slight trailing comfort at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがカメラのファインダーで撮って下さった
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad took a picture of me through his camera viewfinder.
lines.style: Quiet wonder. He's still processing the gift of this moment. Voice stays small and thoughtful. Lingers slightly on the image—he can still see it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの随筆、いつか読んでみたいわね
lines.en: Sho, I do hope you'll read my essays someday, when you're older.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. Speaks with quiet hope—not certainty, but a wish held gently. Slow pace. The words float slightly, like she's imagining a future she wants for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ハサミの使い方上手になったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got really good at using scissors now!
lines.style: Proud and self-aware. Delivered with the specific pride of a six-year-old who has mastered a real thing. Bright, clear articulation. Wants her recognition—and expects it.
